meta.name: endpoint-management
meta.description: Manages laptops, desktops and mobile devices — enrollment, configuration, patching, software distribution, and lost or compromised devices. Use this to set up device management, standardize builds, roll out software or an OS upgrade, handle a lost device, or bring an unmanaged fleet under control.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 统一管理电脑和移动设备,自动下发配置、补丁与软件
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要统一管理公司所有电脑和手机设备。
copy.tagline_en: Manage all your computers and mobile devices, auto-apply configs, patches, and software.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to centrally manage the devices across your organization.

howto.what: 为笔记本电脑、台式机和移动设备提供管理指引：注册设备、统一配置、定期打补丁、分发软件，以及处理丢失或受损设备。
howto.when: 当你要求设置设备管理、统一设备标准、处理丢失设备等场景时触发。

say.text: 帮我为新入职员工的电脑配置标准安全设置
say.note: 会按标准构建生成配置策略

say.text: 制定补丁安装计划，给出强制截止时间
say.note: 会设置补丁节奏与强制期限

say.text: 有一台笔记本丢失了，请按流程处理
say.note: 会给出锁定、定位、擦除等步骤

howto.what_en: Provides guidance for managing laptops, desktops and mobile devices: enrollment, configuration, patching, software distribution, and handling lost or compromised devices.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to set up device management, standardize builds, handle a lost device, or similar.

say_en.text: Help me configure standard security settings for a new employee's laptop.
say_en.note: Generates config policy based on standard build.

say_en.text: Create a patch installation plan with a hard deadline.
say_en.note: Sets patch cadence and enforcement deadline.

say_en.text: A laptop is lost. Please run the procedure.
say_en.note: Provides steps for locking, locating, wiping.
